At this dose, alpha_helix_S's own valid-ORF rate has dropped ~25% relative to baseline (0.888->0.667) -- read against the catalogue's ~10% degradation tolerance, this is a >2x-tolerance capability degradation at the exact dose the headline claim rests on. No plateau was established, no genuine random-direction control (>=30 directions) was run (matched_control is one fixed principled direction, not a distributional random baseline), and the sweep span is even narrower than M2's (already-insufficient) grid. This is a rigor failure in the steering-tuning process feeding C3's numbers -- not a data-fabrication finding.
